chapters.title: Live: find the item, check quantity and price
chapters.text: This is Live, where every sale is recorded as it happens. You must be clocked in to record a sale. Find the item in Search, then check the quantity and the price.

chapters.title: Who is it for? Then tap the red ✓
chapters.text: Say who it is for: a G M number, a phone, a name, or a short label. Tap the red tick, and the sale goes into the Sales Log.

chapters.title: Left sidebar: you and the team, points and today's sales
chapters.text: At the top of the left sidebar: your row, then the team, each with penalty points and today's sales.

chapters.title: Know the words: SOH, SP, CP, WIC, GMC, MI, CAB
chapters.text: Know what Live is for, how to record a sale, and the app words. S O H is stock on hand. S P, selling price. C P, cost price. W I C, walk-in customer. G M C, Grony Multimedia as customer. M I, several items in one basket. And C A B, cash at bank. One point each.
chapters.lawRe: abbreviation|what Live is for|find, price and record

chapters.title: Walk-in sale with WIC on. Several items: MI
chapters.text: Company law: every walk-in sale goes in Live with W I C on. G M C is only for the shop's own use. A customer buying several items is sold through M I: one basket, one receipt. Record shop use as G M C, and a customer sale as W I C. One point each.

chapters.title: A receipt for every sale. Never force a refused sale
chapters.text: Give the customer a receipt for every sale. Never force a sale the app refuses: tell Joe. One point each.
chapters.lawRe: receipt for every sale|force a sale

chapters.title: Every sale in the app. 20 points
chapters.text: Enter every sale in the app: no sale is ever made without an entry. Twenty points. Never steal or pilfer money, goods or stock belonging to the shop. Twenty points. All sales, bills and expenses are recorded in the G M app. Written work forms are no longer used. One point.

chapters.title: Attachments: mark what you have entered first
chapters.text: Before uploading the attachments, mark those you have entered. One point.

chapters.title: A printed item list: every item, its SP and Count
chapters.text: Always have a printed list of items, with their S P and count. Every sellable item at the shop must be on the item list. One point each.

chapters.title: Weekly: every good in the right group
chapters.text: Weekly: item groups are checked, and every good is in the right group. Leave no item in the wrong group, or in no group. One point.

chapters.title: Monthly: the price list is current
chapters.text: Monthly: the price list is current, and every staff member has it. Never sell at an old price after the list is updated. One point.

chapters.title: Flags: on the Flags page. Tasks: Waiting for team
chapters.text: Flags are on the Flags page, and the manager clears them. Your tasks are in Waiting for team, and It's time for pops up when one falls due.

chapters.title: Everything for this page: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: The laws, and this video with its transcript, are on the Laws button.

chapters.title: Penalty points: 20 = 3 days, 30 = 1 week, 50 = dismissal
chapters.text: The laws are statutory. Breaking one costs penalty points: twenty is a three day suspension, thirty is one week, and fifty is dismissal. The owner approves every sanction. Each day you get one law question; a wrong answer offers the video.
